title: Pure Json Output And Error Tests
description: All --json commands should return pure data without extra wrapping. Errors go to stderr. All commands must be tested with semantically wrong arguments.
summary: All --json CLI commands now return pure data without {"data": ...} GraphQL wrapper. Errors emitted to stderr. Cobra SilenceUsage/SilenceErrors set. Wrong-argument tests added for all command categories. TestCliJsonPureData and TestCliJsonErrorsToStderr verify output contract. Full test suite passes.
